title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-025
doc_notes: This document consists of FAA internal routing slips and an alert report regarding the JAL 1628 UFO sighting, containing some illegible handwritten notes on pages 3, 4, and 6.

incidents.summary: JAL flight 1628 reported observing unidentified lighted air traffic in close proximity while en route to Tokyo.
incidents.quote: JAL #1628 Cargo, B747, FL350 enroute to Tokyo via Reykjavik, Iceland, and Anchorage, reported observing lighted air traffic, in close proximity.
